title: 抖音推出门店AI一体机“豆糕”
title_en: Douyin quietly launches "Dougao" AI terminal for local stores
blurb_en: Douyin Life Services launched Dougao, a dual-screen AI device for stores that handles livestreaming, coupon redemption, payments and voice queries, now in 8 Chinese cities.
